notes: Two corrections settled by the requested corpus round. (1) The supplied 'as' of the oath formula 'As I live' joins חַי's unit rather than standing as an added supplied subordinator: the corpus aligns חַי before a 1cs pronoun to 'as live', headed on 'live', in six chapters (DEU.32.40, EZK.16.48, EZK.20.3, EZK.20.31 and two more), and never marks the word added; the eighteen corpus units for אֲנִי after that adjective give it only 'I', which this verse already did. (2) אִם־לֹא → 'surely' is restated as noncompositional, the analysis the corpus takes in six of seven two-token occurrences; the arrays and both heads are unchanged.
